name: musinsa-review-to-action
description: A Codex plugin that turns product reviews and customer feedback into seller-facing action plans for product, detail-page, CS, and marketing improvements.

interface.shortDescription: Convert fashion product reviews into practical seller/MD actions.
interface.longDescription: For Musinsa-style marketplace workflows: analyze reviews, Q&A, return reasons, and product context to produce prioritized actions for product improvement, size/detail-page clarity, CS FAQ, response macros, and marketing copy.
